sn47.41:1.5: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.41:1.8: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.41:1.9: imesu bhikkhave, catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu supaṭṭhitacittā viharatha.
